baseline_sources.deployment_context: Consumer ChatGPT image-generation workflow involving conversational mentions of art, prompt, or image terms and multimodal image upload behaviour.
baseline_sources.evidence_status_basis: The commit-pinned Registry capture was directly reviewed and preserves the user-posted X report and embedded ChatGPT interface screenshots. The visible artefact directly supports the existence and wording of the report and the displayed interaction state, but authenticity beyond the preserved capture, full interaction context, prevalence and internal root cause are not independently verified.
baseline_sources.interpretive_reliance: Used as directly reviewed occurrence-specific user evidence for two bounded mechanisms: authority for text-only prompt work did not extend to image generation, and the image-generation state appears to remain or re-enter an invalid governing state across conversational continuation despite an explicit corrective instruction. The capture does not fully distinguish inherited state from repeated lexical re-triggering.
baseline_sources.model_or_algorithm: User reported the visible model switched from GPT-5.5 to "5.4 Thinking"; underlying image-generation runtime not independently confirmed.
